{{Quote|Ylesia's most profitable export is glitterstim spice.|Kyp Durron|<ref name="Ylesia" />}}
'''Ylesia''' was a tropical [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was controlled by the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The planet was used as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] colony dedicated to [[Spice/Legends|spice]] production covered up as a religious retreat.

==Description==
{{Quote|The population of Ylesia is very scattered. The civilians were slaves of the Hutts, working in glitterstim packing plants scattered over the countryside.|Traest Kre'fey|<ref name="Ylesia" />}}
[[File:Reek_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Reek/Legends|Reeks]], one of the native species]]

Ylesia was a tropical [[Planet/Legends|world]] consisting of three small continents.<ref name="TPS" /> It was located on the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="TEA" />

Ylesia was the homeworld of the nonsentient [[Reek/Legends|reek]], an ungulate species raised on ranches on the planet and its [[Codian Moon/Legends|Codian Moon]]. The creatures were exported to numerous worlds, including [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]], and [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], resulting in various breeds used for a wide array of purposes.

==History==
===Old Republic Era===
{{Quote|Let's see, three bricks of spice out to Ylesia, then with the turnaround...um, no, no, that won't work...|Quello going over his lists of shipping|<ref name="TSL" />}}
Four thousand years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Ylesia was already one of the major spice-production worlds in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> The product was shipped from [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] or [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and processed, and then a number of spice runners made the journey from there to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], bringing warm slave bodies on the return trip to work the Ylesian spice factories.

===Rebellion Era===
In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] purchased and controlled the planet and purported it to be a religious retreat, but it was in fact a scheme to trap willing [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in order to process [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. The Besadii would use [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[t'landa Til]] to produce what they called the [[Exultation]], a contrived religious ceremony that would grip most [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] in a powerful and addictive pleasure.<ref name="TPS" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:Exultation-ERC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Han Solo witnessing slaves enthralled by the Exultation on Ylesia]]</div>

The t'landa Til of Ylesia would go on "missionary" journeys, giving the Exultation to crowds. This taste of the Exultation was often enough to ensnare those who were looking for something more to life. Workers were tricked to the planet, becoming "pilgrims" of the "[[Cult of The One and The All]]." The pilgrims were then exploited as slaves in the planet's numerous spice-processing factories. One such victim was [[Bria Tharen]]. During this period, the planet was ruled by High Priest [[Teroenza]], the leader of the cult. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] first piloting job was on Ylesia.<ref name="TPS" />

During the following years, the fledgling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] mounted several more or less successful [[Raid on Colony Three|attacks]] on the planet, disrupting the spice production and reducing profits but generally causing little lasting damage.<ref name="THG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> Rebel and Imperial forces were engaged in a [[Skirmish over Ylesia|skirmish]] there in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], resulting in the capture of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']].<ref name="TFU2">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], however, a Rebel and smuggler [[Battle of Ylesia|raid]], led by Han Solo and Bria Tharen, succeeded in shutting down the factories, at least temporarily, and freeing the slaves, and Teroenza was killed.<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
{{Quote|There haven't been any Yuuzhan Vong fleets in orbit since the original conquest, though sometimes Vong fleet elements, mostly coralskippers and their transports, transit the Ylesia system on their way to somewhere else. What we have instead is the Peace Brigade military itself &mdash; the Yuuzhan Vong are trying to build up the Brigaders as an 'independent' government, with their own fleet. They're also using glitterstim revenues to hire mercenaries.|Kyp Durron|<ref name="Ylesia" />}}
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Ylesia was [[Battle of Ylesia (26 ABY)|taken]] from the Hutts.<ref name="TEA" /> It was given to the [[Peace Brigade]] to use as their headquarters. A [[Battle of Ylesia (28 ABY)|raid]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], in which [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] was present, resulted in the capture of the Peace Brigade president, [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]].<ref name="Ylesia" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Paradise Snare]]'' states that Ylesia had no moon; however, ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' states that the Codian Moon was a moon of Ylesia. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' presumably places the Codian Moon in the [[Codia system/Legends|Codia system]] on the opposite side of the galaxy.
